description: JS deps of the history-of-math bundle: Clerk 0.18.1158's render (codemirror, markdown-it, katex, framer-motion) and emmy-viewers PR #83's widgets (leva, mafs, mathbox, jsxgraph, mathlive). Clerk's own deps keep the ranges of its render/package.json at v0.18.1158 (pinned codemirror/lezer versions mix two @lezer/common copies and break the bundle). Widget versions follow the CLJS wrappers' deps.cljs: mafs.cljs 0.3.1 needs mafs ^0.18.8, mathbox.cljs 0.2.2 needs three <= 0.150.0. Served beside the pages instead of from CDNs: clerk-katex (katex 0.16.4) and plotly.js-dist-min 2.15.1 are the two packages Clerk's render loads at runtime through d3-require (katex@0.16.4, plotly.js-dist@2.15.1), copied into <out>/vendor; tailwindcss 3.4.17 with @tailwindcss/typography 0.5.16 (the versions Clerk's CDN script serves) compiles Clerk's viewer.css once per build.
